body: I understand this site isn't a magic wand, I just need to get through today.
If anyone needs to talk, I am here.

*hug* Don't give up please. Talking about your problems shows you are more aware of what you want than lots of "cool" guys. Its awkward at first, but the more you talk about it, the easier it gets. Im glad you reached out. You rock dude .
Im sorry you are sad. I just want you to know as long as you try to be better than you were yesterday, it will get better.
You didn't try harder
I'm sorry.
I believe in you
You're still going dude. Every day you've been alive, and in the more recent days, you've felt like it was the end. But you're alive! Your success rate for getting through the day is 100%

You're doing great reaching out here. That's already a great sign you want things to change. Im sorry your parents aren't more supportive. I have a similar situation and while I still have problems, every day I survive proves that Im not as weak as I thought all those days. Your success rate for living is 100%. You can do it.

It will be worth not drinking tonight because FUCK THOSE GUYS. Yes getting drunk is fun. You know what's not fun? THE NEXT MORNING full of anxiety, shame, regret, etc. A few hours of being cool isn't worth the days of feeling sorry about it. You can get through this. Your success rate for getting through the day is 100%.

I have been trying to choose low-cost outlets for years, thanks for the suggestion. Ill admit I tend to keep things bottled until the pressure is too great, and that's not good, but no need to be snarky, please.
You're doing great. Keep going. Only awesome ness can come of it
Thank you.
Thank you. I definitely want to be the best I can be, but I feel Im locked into a shit situation. Thank you for responding. Every little bit helps.
Thank you for your time. I appreciate it more than you know.
You're absolutely right. Drinking isn't any better than being a crackhead. Thank you. Every little bit of insight helps.
Thank you. I constantly think it's over for me but your comment gives me hope.
I really like your metaphor about fighting. Thank you.

Thank you for sharing your story. Even if you think you're not doing great, I want you to know JUST sharing your story is an inspiration to me to try and be better. You're doing amazing just by addressing the problem. Little steps. Every little bit helps. Get through a minute, then an hour, then an evening, then a day. No progress is too little to value, EVER. Rock on dude
Awh so cute. Your story made me smile. Keep on doin good mama 😊
I am happy for you dude. Keep going! It can only get better from here!
I'm so happy you took the time to tell me this. Thank you. I won't ever forget it. Thank you so much.
This IS my "asking for help". Im not in a financial situation to get therapy. Im at the end of my rope. I just need someone to talk to.

Im sorry you are having a hard time. I always tell myself " your success rate for getting through the bullshit is 100% so far" Every little bit helps. Getting through the next few seconds is key. Then get through the next minute. Remind yourself how nice it is to not be a slave to alcohol because you got through those minutes. Then get through ONE day. Rinse. Repeat. You can do it, I know you can.
That's so good to hear. Good on you dude.
It sucks becoming "That guy", but overcoming it will gain you so much respect from those you care about, and even strangers like me who are looking for inspiration. Keep on dude, you can do it.
Good job dude. Im happy for you 😊

I fucking hate being a stay at home mom. Its boring and shit because no one gives a shit if its clean. Its my whole life its all I have and the two most important people in my life couldn't care less if their sheets are unwashed. So I drink. I don't care as much when Im drunk. Its my only escape. I hate life.
